# Hearing Score
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(dplyr)
```

```{r}
clean_df <- read_csv("Data/clean_df.csv")
```
```{r}
freq_table <- table(clean_df$hearing_cond, clean_df$insecticide)
prop.table(freq_table, margin = 2)
```
```{r}
table(clean_df$hearing_cond)
```

```{r}
hearing_conditions <- c("excellent", 
  "good", 
  "little_trouble", 
  "moderate_trouble",
  "lot_trouble", 
  "deaf")

p_val_vec <- unlist(lapply(hearing_conditions, function(col) {
  result <- t.test(
    clean_df[clean_df$insecticide == 1, ][[col]],
    clean_df[clean_df$insecticide == 0, ][[col]]
  )
  result$p.value
}))
```

```{r}
hearing_conditions_df <- data.frame(hearing_conditions, p_val_vec)
```

```{r}
hearing_conditions_df %>% 
  mutate(significant_diff = ifelse(p_val_vec < 0.05, TRUE, FALSE))
```

# Checking Income and Hearing Condition 

```{r}
hearing_income_test <- aov(income_poverty_ratio ~ hearing_cond, data = clean_df)

summary(hearing_income_test)
```

```{r}
TukeyHSD(hearing_income_test)
```

# Checking Age and Hearing Condition 

```{r}
hearing_age_test <- aov(age_years ~ hearing_cond, data = clean_df)

summary(hearing_age_test)
```

```{r}
TukeyHSD(hearing_age_test)
```

# Checking Gender and Hearing Condition 

```{r}
p_val_vec_gender <- unlist(lapply(hearing_conditions, function(col) {
  result <- t.test(
    clean_df[clean_df$gender == "Male", ][[col]],
    clean_df[clean_df$gender == "Female", ][[col]]
  )
  result$p.value
}))
```

```{r}
hearing_conditions_gender_df <- data.frame(hearing_conditions, p_val_vec_gender)
```

```{r}
hearing_conditions_gender_df %>% 
  mutate(significant_diff = ifelse(p_val_vec_gender < 0.05, TRUE, FALSE))
```
